name: Paired mandibles icon
description: UI slot icon for the paired mandibles, composing `ss.proj.boom` via `use`. Third of the weapon icons to be derived from its projectile instead of hand-drawn a second time — the original BootScene authored five weapon shapes twice, with independently tuned coordinates. Rim is `$chitin` — the jaw's own amber rather than the husk it is mostly drawn in, because the Lash already owns bone.

evolved.description: Dancing Mandibles. The rim goes gold the way every evolved slot does, and the one pair of jaws becomes two pairs pinwheeling round the middle of the tile, through the air they drag after them. Two because the evolution throws one more, and every other one spirals the opposite way; each pair is the same `ss.proj.boom` the base slot composes, turned half a circle from the other. Between them are two `ss.fx.gust` — the streaks the weapon lays along its path — swept round the same centre, so the slot shows the spiral and not only the thing riding it. The gusts keep their field alpha: they are the air, and the jaws are what cuts.
